about.en: Dr. Shahzad Ejaz is a premier Senior Laparoscopic and Gastrointestinal Surgeon practicing at Ejaz Clinic, Patna. With over 18 years of specialized clinical and surgical experience, he has garnered an esteemed reputation for surgical precision, low complication rates, and rapid post-operative patient recovery. Having completed an advanced fellowship at the world-renowned Mayo Clinic (Rochester, USA) and being recognized as a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons (FACS), Dr. Ejaz brings international clinical protocols directly to his patients. His compassionate bedside manner and dedication to ethical, evidence-based surgery ensure that each patient receives personalized treatment tailored to their condition.
about.hi: डॉ. शाहजाद एजाज, एजाज क्लिनिक, पटना में एक प्रतिष्ठित वरिष्ठ लैप्रोस्कोपिक और गैस्ट्रोइंटेस्टाइनल सर्जन हैं। 18 से अधिक वर्षों के क्लिनिकल अनुभव के साथ, वे सर्जिकल सटीकता, न्यूनतम जटिलताओं और रोगियों की त्वरित रिकवरी के लिए जाने जाते हैं। विश्व-प्रसिद्ध मेयो क्लिनिक (यूएसए) से उन्नत फेलोशिप प्राप्त और अमेरिकन कॉलेज ऑफ सर्जन्स (FACS) के फेलो होने के नाते, वे अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर के उपचार प्रोटोकॉल प्रदान करते हैं।

Having treated tens of thousands of complex emergency and elective cases, Dr. Ali established Ejaz Clinic to ensure that world-class medical and surgical treatment remains compassionate, dignified, and accessible to every family regardless of financial background.
